title: Soul Mark theme file
description: A theme as its few chosen colors (its seeds). Every other color is derived from these and checked for readability (WCAG AA) by the engine. "solid-tones" is Soul Mark: Solid Tones; "gradients" is Soul Mark: Gradients.

background.description: The background; for a gradient, color 1, at the top.

tint.description: How strongly panels step off the background.

character.description: The tone of the text, which is always chosen for readability.

guard.description: The readability guard. False uses the colors exactly as picked.

color2.description: Gradients only: what color 1 fades to. Never the same as the background.

color3.description: Gradients only: an optional third color after color 2.

shape.description: Gradients only: top to bottom, or an elliptical glow from the top.
